notes.title: Hooray, CUR3D 3.0.3.0 is here! And finally fixes two very annoying bugs
notes.content:
[h1]CUR3D 3.0.3.0 has been released[/h1]
[h2]I am really, really sorry[/h2]
[b]I would like to apologise politely to all those who bought CUR3D and for whom the start-up did not work after the installation. I had to search for the error for an uncomfortably long time and now I hope to have found it and finally fixed it.[/b]

[h3]What had happened?[/h3]
CUR3D Steam Edition (and soon CUR3D Viewer Steam Edition) is based on the same core as CUR3D (without Steam). This makes development easier for me; but also brings its pitfalls when you have to combine different licensing systems and copy protection. What works wonderfully without Steam in the background, reacts quite differently with Steam (or other portals where I still want to publish CUR3D).

So I had to teach my copy protection to distinguish more clearly between several licensing systems and then fire it more "intelligently".

[h3]The result is something to be proud of[/h3].
New customers should now be able to have CUR3D launched immediately without a second (or even a completely unsuccessful) launch!

[h2]On our own behalf[/h2]
[i]Please give CUR3D and me a second chance. I put a lot of effort and love into my work to be able to offer you an uncomplicated, performant and cost-effective 3D printing prepress for the repair of 3D data. I always have an ear for your wishes and problems and will work through them bit by bit.[/i]

[b]Many kind regards,
Christian

CEO
CUR3D UG (haftungsbeschränkt)[/b]

notes.title: Workaround found if CUR3D does not start after purchase
notes.content:
[b]We're really sorry that we didn't know about the problem for so long! It was only thanks to the great Steam support that we noticed the error and we are working flat out on the bug fix.

[h1]Until then, we recommend the following workaround[/h1].
If CUR3D displays an empty user interface after starting, please proceed as follows:

[olist]
[*]Please install the free CUR3D Maker Edition demo version [url=https://cur3d.de/shop/cur3d-maker-edition/cur3d-makeredition-demo/]https://cur3d.de/shop/cur3d-maker-edition/cur3d-makeredition-demo/[/url] from our website.
[*]Install the demo version and enter your licence data sent to you by e-mail after the start.
[*]Now you can close the CUR3D demo version again.
[*]Now start your purchased CUR3D Steam Edition as usual in Steam.
[If everything went well, you should now be able to see the entire user interface of the CUR3D Steam Edition.
[/olist]

[h2]As I said, we are really, really sorry about this. We promise you that there will be a patch in the next few days that will fix the problem for good.[/h2]

[h3]Thank you very much for your understanding and support![/h3]

Christian,
CEO
CUR3D UG (limited liability)

tags.bug: We are working flat out on the bug fix.

notes.title: CUR3D Steam Edition is alive
notes.content:
[h1]Long live CUR3D[/h1]
[b]Perhaps one or the other noticed: RUHRSOURCE GmbH - the company that originally developed CUR3D - had to file for bankruptcy in October 2020. However, we do not let our loyal CUR3D customers down! [url=https://www.cur3d.de]CUR3D lives and will be further developed by CUR3D UG (limited liability).[/url][/b]

[h2](Almost) everything new[/h2]
At that time, RUHRSOURCE GmbH dedicated itself to simplifying additive manufacturing. The young startup from Bochum succeeded in doing that too. In a very short time they blossomed into a respected service provider for 3D printing. Above all, however, the transfer of knowledge about getting started with and professionalizing 3D printing for everyone was the top priority. The main reason was the release of the CUR3D software in November 2016, which greatly simplifies 3D printing. Since then, every 3D model can be 3D printed in every scale without a lot of technical know-how.

The founders of CUR3D UG (limited liability) adhere to this. From the former developers, the heads of development - Christopher Maiwald (external CTO) and Ernst Christian Fleischmann (CEO) - are still with us.

[b]CUR3D UG (limited liability) has been exclusively responsible for the development and sales of the 3D printing prepress CUR3D since June 2021.[/b]

The official sale of version 3.0.2.0 started with resounding success in October 2021.

[h3]Liebe Steam-Community, DANKE![/h3]
[b]Without you, the makers, hobbyists and 3D printing enthusiasts, CUR3D would not exist.[/b]
Thank you for making CUR3D what it is and will be.

[h2]What has changed in CUR3D version 3.0.2.0?[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Windows 7 wird wieder unterstützt[/b]
[list]
[*]CUR3D stopped working on Windows 7 due to a bug that occurred through a security log. We have fixed this problem.
[/list] 
[*][b]The shop, service provider and online library for 3D printers have been removed again[/b]
[list]
[*]Between us: this feature didn't feel right and was immature, which is why we (for now) removed it.
[/list]
[*][b]Bugfix: When switching from the summary to the settings, the previously set values changed.[/b]
[list]
[*]The default values were displayed again. This was related to the online library for 3D printers, which we are also revising. The problem is now solved.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Feature: Creation of 3D printer profiles[/b]
[list]
[*]A feature that is already available in the Professional Edition is the creation of 3D printer profiles. You will be able to create your own profiles for your 3D printer. There is currently only one fictitious example 3D printer in your library ("RUHRSOURCE Generic 3D Printer"). This has the interior dimensions 150 x 150 x 150 mm.
[*]With your own profiles you are able to compare the automatic calculations of CUR3D on your 3D printer.
[/list]
[*][b]DLC: File format *.step/ *.stp[/b]
[list]
[*]With this you are able to process step files.
[*]Unfortunately, due to licensing fees, this file format DLC cannot be offered as cheaply as the others, which we are very sorry about.
[/list]
[*][b]DLC: File format *.iges/ *.igs[/b]
[list]
[*]With this you are able to process Iges files.
[*]Unfortunately, due to licensing fees, this file format DLC cannot be offered as cheaply as the others, which we are very sorry about.
[/list]
[*][b]DLC: Object tree[/b]
[list]
[*]This enables you to print individual details from 3D models that consist of several objects.
[*]The object tree only works with file formats that support nested 3D objects. For example *.obj or *.3ds
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Unfortunately, we still have to address something unpleasant[/h1]
[h2]The return of CUR3D after extensive use[/h2]
[h3]If you don't necessarily need CUR3D, please use the free demo version[/h3]
Unfortunately, we often found in the past that CUR3D was purchased, used extensively and then reimbursed for the purchase price. Thanks to us, these "customers" had a 3D printable 3D model that they probably wouldn't have without us and we went completely empty-handed.

[b]Please don't do that. The development of CUR3D must be financed.[/b]

If you "just want to try out" CUR3D, please use one of our demo versions: [url=https://cur3d.de/product-category/demo/]https://cur3d.de/product-category/demo/[/url]

This gives us a better overview of the development and financing of CUR3D. Wrong refund reasons do not help in the further development of CUR3D.

[b]Thank you![/b]

notes.title: 15 new DLCs will be released on April 1st and more will follow!
notes.content:
[h1]15 brand new file format DLCs[/h1]
The Steam Edition is primarily intended for makers and most of you won't need more file formats than the already integrated ones (STL, OBJ and 3MF). You can probably deal with converters and create the desired file format.

[h2]But if you want to be comfortable ...[/h2]
...can expand its CUR3D Steam Edition from April 1st with the following file formats:
[list]
[*]3DStudio Max (*.3ds, *.ase)
[*]AC3D (*.ac)
[*]Additive Manufacturing File (*.amf)
[*]Autodesk (*.fbx)
[*]Blender (*.blend)
[*]Cinema4D (*.c4d)
[*]Collada (*.dae)
[*]Extensible 3D (*.x3d)
[*]GL Transmission Format (*.gltf, *,glb)
[*]Industry Foundation Classes (*.ifc)
[*]Milkshape 3D (*.ms3d)
[*]Modo (*.lxo)
[*]Stanford Polygon Library (*.ply)
[*]Virtual Reality Modeling Language (*.wrl)
[*]XGL (*.xgl, *.zgl)
[/list]

[h2]Other file formats will follow shortly:[/h2]
[list]
[*]DirectX (*.x)
[*]LightWave (*.lwo, *.lws)
[/list]

notes.title: Known bugs in the new version
notes.content:
[h1]Dear community,[/h1]
[b]the CUR3D Steam Edition, like every new development, is not entirely free of errors. Therefore we ask for your help:[/b]

To improve the quality of our software and to offer you the CUR3D that you deserve, we ask that you post any bugs you find in the discussion forum here in the Steam community. We promise you that we will look at each problem and deal with it afterwards.

We look forward to your feedback!

[h1]Issues currently known[/h1]

[olist]
[*][b]BUG: CUR3D reports when starting for the first time that the license server cannot be reached or the license data is invalid.[/b]
[list]
[*]Temporary solution: Please exit CUR3D "clean", ie close the message and exit CUR3D. At the next start, the message will no longer appear.
[*]This problem will be fixed in the next update.
[/list]
[*][b]BUG: CUR3D reports after a successful start several times that the license server cannot be reached or the license data is invalid.[/b]
[list]
[*]Reason: CUR3D crashed more than twice in a row and could not be ended properly or logged off from the server.
[*]Temporary solution:
[olist]
[*]Exit CUR3D
[*]Please contact us directly: info@ruhrsource.com (subject: "CUR3D Steam Edition License BUG")
[*]We will reset your license and notify you
[*]Restart CUR3D
[/olist]
[*]This problem will be fixed in the next update.
[/list]
[*][b]BUG: Crash due to a culture error when closing the send-crash-log-dialog.[/b]
[list]
[*]Temporary solution: Change to the directory [b]%localappdata%\\RUHRSOURCE[/b] in Windows Explorer and delete all files that end with [b]*.log[/b] and [b]app.templog[/b], too.
[*]This problem will be fixed in the next update.
[/list]
[/olist]

notes.title: Great changes await you
notes.content:
[b]For [i]sad reasons[/i] our last update is unfortunately very long ago.
Meanwhile, a lot has happened in CUR3D (without Steam). Since our worldwide Steam customers, also in Indonesia and China, are very close to our hearts, we will release a new update in the very near future: CUR3D Maker Edition (with Steam) becomes CUR3D Steam Edition![/b]

[h1]What are the advantages of the CUR3D Steam Edition?[/h1]
CUR3D Steam Edition (short: CUR3D SE) does more: CUR3D SE always contains the latest core of CUR3D and at the same time as the regular version without Steam. Furthermore, CUR3D Steam Edition will be expandable via DLC from the simple Maker Edition (non-commercial) to the Professional Edition (commercial). The "Permission for commercial use" DLC will be replaced by the Elements DLC.

In plain language this means:
[list]
[*]Significantly faster availability of updates ...
[*]... and features
[*]... and bug fixes
[*]DLC: Elements (Subscription or lifetime; for commercial use)
[*]DLC: Advanced (Subscription or lifetime; for commercial use)
[*]DLC: Professional (Subscription or lifetime; for commercial use)
[/list]

notes.title: CUR3D Maker Edition (without Steam)
notes.content:
Love community,

Unfortunately, working on the Steam Edition of CUR3D takes longer than planned. We are very sorry.

[b][i]Therefore, if you are considering purchasing the CUR3D Maker Edition, we would ask you to buy the CUR3D Maker Edition (without Steam).[/i][/b]

These can be found in our online shop:
[url=https://www.ruhrsource.com/shop/cur3d-maker-edition-without-steam-lifetime-lizenz/]https://www.ruhrsource.com/shop/cur3d-maker-edition-without-steam-lifetime-lizenz/[/url]

[i][b]Likewise, we offer anyone who has already bought the Maker Edition (with Steam) a free change from the Maker Edition to the Maker Edition without Steam.[/b][/i]

[b]What are the advantages of the CUR3D Maker Edition (without Steam):[/b]
[list]
[*]significantly faster updates; in the same rhythm as the other CUR3D versions
[*]No Steam Client in the background
[/list]

We know that we do not make friends with Steam internally with this news. But our Maker Community on Steam is important to us.

[h1]What do I have to do to switch?[/h1]`
This is quite simple: Just send me (Christian) an e-mail to [b]steam@ruhrsource.com[/b], put [b]"CUR3DME: I need to switch"[/b] in the subject, and I'll explain everything else in my reply mail.

Many greetings from Bochum,
Christian of RUHRSOURCE

notes.title: Workaround fix online now!
notes.content:
Another final fix will follow soon.

[b]If anyone has problems since the Halloween update, please follow these steps:[/b]
1. Open the Steam Library
2. Steam library on "Software"
3. Right click on "CUR3D Maker Edition"
4. Open "Properties"
5. Select "Local Files" tab
6. Click on "Check files for errors"

Then a download starts and the wrong file is exchanged. Now the problem should be fixed. As mentioned above, we still publish a final fix that replaces the workaround.
